label: 4MP 25x IR PTZ speed dome
description: 4 MP outdoor PTZ with 25x optical zoom, 100 m IR and auto-tracking, on a single RJ45 10/100 port. Demands PoE+ 802.3at and draws up to 18 W when the motors and IR are both running.
notes: PoE class 802.3at (PoE+), 25.5 W at the PSE, 18 W actual - the device that fails on an 802.3af-only switch. Wired only; 12 VDC alternative. Pan/tilt burst current is the reason to leave headroom on the port.
